description.sub_name: 全球能源經濟趨勢與發展
description.sub_ename: ENERGY ECONOMICS AND DEVELOPMENT A GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE
description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹能源經濟之基本問題及解決方案。內容包括如何提高能源生產和使用的效率以及氣候變化時代的可持續性，以及與經濟繁榮、環保和福利有關之當代政策決定框架。從而培養學生分析全球能源轉型與經濟變遷之能力。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to introduce the fundamental issues of energy economics and pose the possible solutions to those issues. This includes how to enhance the efficiency of energy production and use as well as how to take account of sustainability in the age of climate change. This course also aims to present a framework of decision making by considering economic prosperity, environmental protection, and societal well-being that are central to many contemporary policies. Students attending this course are expected to acquire a skill for analyzing energy transition and economic change from a global perspective.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Classroom Rules
Attendance is very important. While students are not required to attend every class, frequent absences will definitely affect the final grade and may even result in failing the course.
To avoid disrupting other students' learning, please keep your voice low when having private conversations in class. If the volume is too loud, I will remind you.
If you miss the mid-semester group presentation or semester-end assessment, you must provide a valid leave request. Make-up assessments due to sick leave, bereavement leave, or other major reasons will be graded based on the make-up exam score. If the absence is unexcused, the make-up exam score will be reduced by 20%.

課堂規則
出席會是一件很重要的事.雖然同學不被強制要求每堂課都要到課,但經常性的缺席一定會影響學期成績,甚至不及格.
為了避免影響其他同學學習狀況,在課堂上私下說話交談時務必壓低音量.若音量太大,我會提醒同學.
期中報告或期末評估缺席需有請假證明.因病假喪假或重大理由補考後以補考分數計算,若無故缺考,補考分數打八折計算.
